QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque(x)` returns `x ^ mbedtls_ct_zero`, where `mbedtls_ct_zero` is a `volatile` global set to 0 in `library/constant_time.c`. The compiler cannot prove that value, so it cannot specialise on the input.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names the primitive and its purpose, but it places the definition in `library/constant_time.c`, not `library/constant_time_impl.h`. The only mention of the `_impl.h` file is the general statement that all primitives live there, with no link to `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque`.
